data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for RevenueCat paywalls and customer center UI
data.what_it_does: Provides widgets and helper methods to display RevenueCat paywalls and customer center in a Flutter app. It wraps native SDKs for iOS and Android and offers both modal and inline presentations.
use_when: You need to show RevenueCat paywalls or customer center in your app
You want a ready‑made UI that handles platform differences automatically
You prefer declarative widget usage over manual native integration
avoid_when: You are building a custom paywall UI from scratch
You need fine‑grained control over the native SDK beyond what the plugin exposes
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single dependency
Offers both modal and inline widgets
weaknesses: Limited to RevenueCat SDK, no custom backend support
No build_runner or codegen needed but no advanced customization
data.setup_notes: Add purchases_flutter and purchases_ui_flutter to pubspec, run flutter pub get. No additional native steps required beyond standard RevenueCat setup.
